description: This file defines the SugarFieldReadonly class, which extends the SugarFieldBase class. It provides a method to retrieve the Smarty template for the edit view, which internally delegates to the detail view Smarty method.

classes.name: SugarFieldReadonly
classes.description: A class representing a read-only field in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, extending the base field class and providing a method to get its edit view rendering.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the Smarty template for the edit view of the read-only field, delegating to the detail view Smarty method.
